description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminLeaderboard page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It includes event handlers for page load, navigation buttons, and a session-based search feature, with database connection code commented out.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminLeaderboard page, handling user interactions and navigation within the admin leaderboard interface.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; contains commented-out code for fetching and binding user data to a GridView.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminPanel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminQueue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle actions when the leaderboard button is clicked; currently empty.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Handles search actions, sets session variable based on selected semester; database query code is commented out.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the LoginPage.
